market_view: The market is in a clear risk-off regime with SPY down 0.5% and VIXY up 2.9%, indicating caution. With only 5% of watched stocks up and broad weakness in tech, I will prioritize short setups on breakdowns and avoid long momentum plays unless there is a strong counter-trend catalyst. The Flash PMI release at 9:45 AM ET adds volatility risk, so I will keep position sizes conservative.

decisions.reason: Arista Networks disclosed a critical vulnerability (CVE-2026-114625) in its VeloCloud Orchestrator, creating immediate negative sentiment. The stock is already down 7.9% over 5 days and RSI is 28.3, suggesting continued weakness. Shorting on this specific news catalyst in a risk-off tape aligns with my successful shorting strategy.

News indicates money is exiting AI stocks and Nvidia faces competitive pressure from Apple closing in on its market cap. RSI is 29.5 and the stock is below its 50-day average. In a risk-off market, high-beta AI leaders often lead the decline. This is a continuation short setup.

Applied Materials has an RSI of 5.1 (extremely oversold) but is part of a broader semi-equipment downtrend (5d -12.7%). The 'China demand' news is negative. While RSI is low, the trend is strongly down. I will short the bounce or continuation of weakness, using a tight stop to manage risk if it reverses sharply.
